li.label: healthy trees
li.description: In the past quadrum, we didn't destroy many trees at all. Harmony with the trees is the basic foundation for a good life.

li.label: trees disturbed
li.description: In the past quadrum, we have destroyed trees we shouldn't have. It might have been necessary, but it is still an occasion for sadness.

li.label: trees defaced
li.description: In the past quadrum, we have destroyed a lot of trees we shouldn't have. I don't think this was necessary.

li.label: trees damaged
li.description: In the past quadrum, we have destroyed many trees we shouldn't have. This crime was not necessary, but we did it anyways.

li.label: trees harmed
li.description: In the past quadrum, we have destroyed an inexcusable number of trees. We need to do so much better.

li.label: trees defiled
li.description: In the past quadrum, we have destroyed an inexcusably large number of trees. The guilt lays heavy upon us.

li.label: trees wrecked
li.description: In the past quadrum, we have destroyed a very large number of trees. I can hear the leafy screams even now.

li.label: trees ravaged
li.description: In the past quadrum, we have destroyed a horrific number of trees. We are the blight on this universe.
